title.en: An Act Changing the Name of Gardenia street, in the District of Sampaloc, City of Manila, to General Licerio Geronimo.

text.en:
The street in the district of Sampaloc, City of Manila, known as Gardenia, shall hereafter be
known as General Licerio Geronimo Street, in commemoration of the late revolutionary leader General
Licerio Geronimo.

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, December 6, 1930.
